thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH GPU QUEUE - cluster-gpu-us-east-1. metric: gpu.queue.length > 500 for 5m. Severity: P2. Triggered by prometheus-alerts.
oncall-sam: I'm taking this, joining bridge now.
Alex SRE: I'm on mobile but looking at autoscaler logs, will paste errors in a sec.
Julia Runtime: Telemetry: inference-requests backlog spiked 00:12 -> 00:55. 95p latency up, error rate to customers ~1.8%. Possible scale fail.
Raj ML: Observed model-serving pods piling up in queue (reranker/large-model). Throughput dropped ~60% for GPU-backed routes.
Elaine CS: CS pinged on early reports, a few enterprise customers seeing timeouts. Notified affected parties with short blurb.
oncall-sam: deploy-bot, can you post the autoscaler event stream?
deploy-bot: autoscaler-events: 3 attempts to scale up nodegroup 'gpu-hotpool-v3' -> API failure. Last error: "ClientError: RunInstances failed - UnauthorizedOperation: iam:PassRole". See /var/log/autoscaler/events.log excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T00:37:10Z scale attempt id=af3d
error: ec2:RunInstances UnauthorizedOperation iam:PassRole arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/gpu-host-profile
```
Alex SRE: That matches what I see. Autoscaler tried to create instances with LT version 6; our current ASG expects LT v8. LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch + passrole denied. Autoscaler didn't fallback.
Julia Runtime: Also seeing taint propagation failing: newly created nodes (old LT) came up with taint 'NoSchedule:gpu-role' missing correct label, so kubelet registration failed for GPU pool.
Jen Ops: Checking IAM changes - there was a recent rotation on the instance profile last week during the launchtemplate rollout. Looks like the ASG launch template still references older instance profile ARN.
oncall-sam: Customer impact? Raj?
Raj ML: Charts: queue length peaked 820; sustained >500 for 22 minutes. Some requests retried and fell back to smaller models but end-to-end latency increased, ~4 customers reported degraded KPIs. No full outages.
Elaine CS: Notified customers that we're investigating and implementing mitigation. Asking for ETA.
Alex SRE: Short mitigation plan: 1) manual create nodegroup with correct LT v8 + correct instance-profile so we get immediate capacity from hotpool, 2) temporarily lift autoscaler cooldown and force scale to spare-capacity pool, 3) add routing fallback to non-GPU region for highest priority customers.
oncall-sam: Do we have permission to create nodegroup manually? Jen?
Jen Ops: I can create the nodegroup if someone provides the validated LT id and instance-profile ARN. I have perms.
Alex SRE: LT id for working config: lt-0a7b8c9d:v8, instance-profile: arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/gpu-host-profile
Alex SRE: Command I'll run:
```
aws eks create-nodegroup --cluster-name cluster-gpu-us-east-1 --nodegroup-name manual-gpu-burst --scaling-config minSize=1,maxSize=8,desiredSize=4 --node-role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/gpu-node-role --launch-template id=lt-0a7b8c9d,version=8
```
Jen Ops: On it, creating nodegroup now. Posting status.
deploy-bot: nodegroup create initiated id=ng-0xy, expected ready ~10-12m.
Julia Runtime: While that spins up, I'll patch the autoscaler config to allow fallback to 'gpu-spot-alt' pool on failure and reduce pod disruption by increasing pod priority for critical routes.
oncall-sam: Raj, start moving highest priority queues to smaller models as temporary fallback (canary customers only).
Raj ML: Starting canary reroute for top 5 tenants. Will monitor error budgets.
Jen Ops: nodegroup ng-0xy reached READY at +9m. Nodes registered but had taint mismatch; removing stale taint and label correction applied.
Alex SRE: Verified nodes registered, kubelet labels: gpu=true, node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu=1. Autoscaler now sees node capacity. Forcing one scaling iteration.
deploy-bot: autoscaler health check: recovered. Recent scale events: +4 nodes added, backlog drain rate improving.
Raj ML: Queue length trending down: 820 -> 120 in 14m, error rate dropping. High-priority tenants moved to fallback show improved latency.
Elaine CS: Emailed customers with initial update and ETA for full resolution (queue drained estimated 20m).
Alex SRE: Root cause summary (short): Launch template version drift + instance-profile rotation caused autoscaler RunInstances failures (iam:PassRole) and taint/label mismatch on nodes from older LT. Autoscaler didn't graceful-fallback.
oncall-sam: Resolution: manual nodegroup with corrected LT and instance-profile. Autoscaler config patched for fallback pool. Backlog drained.
Alex SRE: Postmortem tasks: (1) Add preflight check in rollout pipeline to ensure LT & instance-profile consistency (owner: eng-infra), (2) Autoscaler: add retry+fallback policy for LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch and PassRole errors (owner: eng-sre), (3) Improve alerting to include 'autoscaler runinstances auth error' classifier for faster triage (owner: eng-runtime).
Elaine CS: I'll send a follow-up customer-facing summary after we have postmortem notes.
oncall-sam: Thanks everyone. Monitoring window 60m. I'll close the page once we're stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: GPU backlog cleared, incident closed by oncall-sam.
